tasks.description: Scaffold repository: layout, continuity files, subagents, commands

ingest/dma.py: download Danish AIS for a date range, land as Parquet partitioned by date. Real day landed 2026-09-16: 2024-06-05, 17,239,519 rows, 4,878 distinct MMSI, format confirmed .zip, served from the DMA's S3 archive (web.ais.dk is dead, see docs/DECISIONS.md)
Open the Parquet with DuckDB; confirm column schema, row count, distinct vessel count. Done 2026-09-16 against the real 2024-06-05 day
Render one day of vessel positions on a static map. Done against the real 2024-06-05 day: outputs/quicklook_2024-06-05.png
Dockerfile and reproducible environment
Clean AIS: drop invalid MMSI, impossible coordinates, duplicate messages. process/clean.py, validated against real 2024-06-05 day: 17,239,519 -> 10,429,200 rows
Identity resolution: link MMSI to IMO, detect reused and orphaned MMSI. process/identity.py, validated against real day: 4,519 MMSI, 1,304 with valid IMO, 3,215 orphaned
Reconstruct tracks per vessel and segment into voyages. process/tracks.py, 6h gap threshold (parameterized), validated against real day: 4,751 voyages
Unit tests with synthetic cases for each cleaning pathology. Satisfied by the test suites built alongside P1-1/P1-2/P1-3: 54 tests total, all passing

Empirical coverage map: receive probability per sea grid cell and vessel class. detect/coverage.py, built over 2024-06-01..2024-06-30: 9,265 cells, 42,968 (cell, ship_type) estimates with >=20 pairs. FLAGGED: selection-bias/circularity in the short/long-gap-ratio method (62.5% of estimates are exactly 1.0, none below 0.5) -- see P2-1b and docs/DECISIONS.md

Fixed P2-1's coverage-map bias via cross-vessel corroboration: detect/liveness.py, a tri-state verdict (receiver_alive/area_dark/no_evidence) with leave-one-out on both the concurrent count and the historical baseline. coverage_probability/grid.parquet retired outright (62.5% of estimates were exactly 1.0, no discriminative range). Validated on the full real 30-day window (11,556 gaps): 85.0/2.5/12.5% split, duration-matched placebo clears the falsification bar for short-to-medium gaps (+19.0/+16.6 points) but only weakly for 12h+ gaps (+6.4 points) -- see docs/DECISIONS.md. Tramo B (coverage.py -> cadence.parquet) deferred to a future session

Detector 1: deliberate AIS gaps. detect/gaps.py: every consecutive voyage pair in voyages.parquet is a candidate gap, scored via detect.liveness.liveness_verdict on cells from both endpoints. Verdict -> probability table (receiver_alive=0.9, area_dark=0.15, no_evidence=0.5), clamped to [0.4, 0.6] for gaps >=12h per the known corroboration weakness there. All thresholds unvalidated defaults. 14 new tests (140 total), ruff clean

Detector 2: position spoofing. detect/spoofing.py, four independent checks over clean AIS, one row per detected event: impossible speed (>50kn implied via consecutive-pair great-circle distance, only for pairs >=60s apart), on land (point-in-polygon against ingest/landmask.py's Natural Earth land polygons, eroded 1.1km inward, cropped to a quantile-based bbox, land mask exploded via ST_Dump into small-bbox pieces, join chunked per day partition), synthetic circles (Kasa algebraic circle fit per voyage via bulk grouped SQL, not per-voyage queries; angular spread via mean resultant length), simultaneous positions (same mmsi/timestamp pairs >500m apart). New ingest/landmask.py downloads+lands the land polygons once. Fully closed: code unit-tested (180 tests, ruff clean), real 30-day run completed and corrected -- see docs/DECISIONS.md for all 5 real-data fixes, including a P2-4-session fix to ST_Distance_Sphere's reversed argument order in this DuckDB build (final counts: 10,098,760 events: impossible_speed 5,499, on_land 10,092,010, synthetic_circle 93, simultaneous_position 1,158). on_land's volume sanity-checked and explained by legitimate long-duration dockside dwell, not a bug.

Detector 3: ship-to-ship transfers, using the GFW definition. detect/anchorages.py (empirical coastal-anchorage mask, 15 tests) + detect/sts.py (the detector, 22 tests): episode segmentation fixing a 647-hour false-encounter artifact, GFW's structural hard gates, and a six-term rule-based confidence score (not a calibrated probability). Fully closed: 202 tests, ruff clean. Real 30-day run: 1,255,460 candidate episodes -> 1,689 survive the hard gates (mean confidence 0.382, 17.6 min), sanity-checked -- see docs/DECISIONS.md and docs/STATE.md.

Detector 4: identity anomalies. detect/identity_anomalies.py (8 kinds: no_valid_imo, name/callsign change+flapping, reused_mmsi, shared_imo with cross_mid, shared_identity) + detect/identity_anomalies.build_vessel_links (data/identity/vessel_links.parquet) + new process/mid.py. Reframed per P1-2: gates on 'ever validly Tanker/Cargo without a valid IMO', not the 71% global orphaned-MMSI rate. Real 30-day run: 265 events (no_valid_imo 91, name_change 47, name_flapping 60, callsign_change 12, callsign_flapping 22, reused_mmsi 1 matching process.identity exactly, shared_imo 18 with 14 cross_mid, shared_identity 14), 28 MMSI linked into 14 vessel groups, ~4.5min wall-clock. 32 new tests (242 total), ruff clean. A dedicated review pass found and fixed 4 temporal-leakage bugs before close -- see docs/DECISIONS.md.

Detector 5: declared-behaviour contradictions. detect/behaviour.py: destination_course_mismatch (declared destination matched to a port by name; flags median COG-to-bearing deviation >90 deg over >=10 points, >=20km from port, >=2.0kn SOG -- COG used instead of heading, 91% vs 76% coverage) + draught_change_unexplained (>=2m median-draught change between consecutive voyages with no port/anchorage or STS evidence in the gap). Both scoped to MMSI with a valid IMO (P2-5's reframing). Real 30-day run: 916 events (152 destination_course_mismatch / 117 MMSI, 764 draught_change_unexplained / 586 MMSI), ~55s. A dedicated review pass found and fixed three real bugs before close: an impossible knowable_at for the draught check (now window_end, whole-window not gap-bounded), an anchorage-evidence self-exoneration circularity (now leave-one-out, mirroring detect.sts's P2-1b fix), and ~24-30% of course-check events being stationary-vessel COG noise (now gated on SOG). 13 tests, ruff clean.
